name: Sparkle Magic Text
description: Centered headline with one highlighted phrase in an animated flowing gradient, surrounded by small spinning, pulsing stars that drift to new positions and move faster on hover.
contents: Headline made of prefix text, a highlighted gradient phrase and suffix text
Sparkle stars scattered around the highlighted phrase
behavior: Gradient on the highlighted phrase pans continuously
Stars spin, pulse and glide to random positions at an interval
Hovering the phrase makes every star relocate on each tick
Typography scales across mobile, tablet and desktop
